about.title: The main forum for Software Engineering & Development in Brazil
about.p1: Promoted by the Brazilian Computer Society (SBC), CBSOFT brings together, once a year, four national symposia into a single program. Researchers, graduate students and industry professionals share results, discuss open problems and build the research agenda for Software Engineering, Formal Methods, Reusable Architectures and Software Testing in Brazil.
about.p2: In 2027 the congress arrives in Belo Horizonte, one of Brazil's most active innovation and startup hubs — with a program that mixes scientific tracks, an industry track, tutorials, tool demonstrations and a thesis & dissertation contest.

registration.title: Registration fees
registration.intro: Fees are per person and grant access to the full program (all symposia, tracks, tutorials and social events). Values in Brazilian reais (BRL).
registration.note: Student rates require valid enrollment proof. At least one author per accepted paper must register by the camera-ready deadline.
